record.question: Which of the following is correct regarding the RBI’s proposed polymer banknote trial in India?
options: The trial will cover ₹ 10 and ₹ 20 denominations, alongside existing paper notes.
The trial will cover all denominations currently issued by the RBI.
The trial will initially focus on ₹ 500 and ₹ 2,000 denominations.
The trial will replace existing paper notes in the selected denominations.
